ai-at-work.title: Agentic AI has become an organization-wide imperative, says Google Cloud CTO
ai-at-work.excerpt: The innovation race has entered a new phase with enterprise agentic AI spreading across every part of the business. The potential of agents — once limited to technical teams — is quickly becoming acce
ai-at-work.dwp_take: Google Cloud is saying agentic AI (software agents that act autonomously) has moved from niche technical projects to something every department should be using right now. For digital workplace leaders, this means you're going to start fielding requests to deploy AI agents across finance, HR, ops, and everywhere else, which brings real questions about governance, security, and whether your infrastructure can actually handle it. Here's my take: before you sprint into agentic AI because a vendor told you it's an "imperative," figure out what problem you're actually solving, because autonomously running agents in your production environment without controls is how you get some very expensive mistakes.
